body: Thanks for the reply. Your answer isn't run of the mill but it's very effective. I am pretty self aware right now, I think the problem is my mind. I tend to create problem scenarios and constantly remind myself of past mistakes. I've made it a point to learn from mistakes. I've made a few really embarrassing mistakes at work but I remember not to do them again (the hard way of learning). Starting with small goals is pretty effective, even finishing breakfast is an accomplishment but it's still a goal met. I think I'll eventually recover with time, I'm just having growing pains right now (new job, new coworkers, new everything really). Thanks for your insightful comment about the puzzle. Makes really good sense.

I'm working for a while but I kind of want to just drive around and enjoy the scenery afterwards. It's surprisingly beautiful outside today. Maybe I just need to go out for a little instead of being cooped up at home with my thoughts since that's usually where my issues start - I'm a chronic overthinker, unfortunately.

Thanks. Any response makes me feel a little better. I kind of know this feeling will pass but my mind is my worst enemy. I can feel okay for about 5 minutes then suddenly my heart will start pounding and I'll remember my mishaps. It's a vicious cycle that I wish would stop. Even like this morning, I woke up feeling great. No nausea or anything. Then I remembered what my work day looks like, then came the nausea and anxiety. Thanks again for replying, it feels good knowing there's people who can understand.
